headline: On October 15, 2003: China launches Shenzhou 5, its first crewed space mission
captionCards: China became the 3rd nation with human spaceflight capability
Last solo orbital mission as of October 2026
instagramCaption:
China makes history with Shenzhou 5. \\ On October 15, 2003, China launched its first crewed space mission, Shenzhou 5, on a Long March 2F rocket. This mission made China the third country to independently send humans into space, following the Soviet Union/Russia and the United States. The spacecraft had four previous uncrewed missions since 1999. As of October 2026, this was the last time an astronaut was launched alone for a solo orbital mission. \\ Why is this still significant today?
